title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Electronic Trust Transfers
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: When making an electronic transfer of funds out of a mixed trust account (such as an EFT or wire transfer) to pay a settlement, what specific LSO accounting requirement must be met?
options: The paralegal must only transfer the money on the 15th of the month.
The paralegal must fill out, sign, and retain an electronic trust transfer requisition (Form 9A) or an equivalent hardcopy record.
The paralegal must call the Law Society for verbal approval.
Trust funds can never be transferred electronically; they must be withdrawn by physical certified cheque.
questions.explain: Under LSO By-law 9, while electronic trust transfers are permitted, the licensee must complete, sign, and retain a specific requisition form (commonly Form 9A) detailing the transaction, client matter, and authorization, ensuring an audit trail identical to a physical cheque.
